name: zephyrus
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Zephyrus instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Zephyrus tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Zephyrus through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Zephyrus Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Zephyrus only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
